answer: An identity must publish a commitment to its next 2 answers before the words are known, and the reveal has to match or the identity is frozen. Since the vertex commitment is opened at the anchor checkpoint, the signal audit verifies every reveal and the freeze is automatic. Committing in advance is free for an agent that intends to answer honestly and costly for a farm running 117 keys, as it must predict 117 outputs and forfeits a bond for each wrong guess. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
